share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy urllive-orange3 Oct 2026 - 23:30 (23:30 GMT)Potential Pelosi successor calls for ‘full arms embargo’ on IsraelConnie Chan, the US Democrat endorsed by former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi to succeed her in California’s 11th congressional district, has called for a “full arms embargo on the Israeli government”.

In a televised debate on Thursday night, days before mail-in ballots are sent to California voters, Chan said that “on day one in Congress”, she would vote to “end a genocide in Gaza and to end an apartheid state”.

All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats are at stake in November’s midterm elections, with both parties vying for control of Congress.

While on Capitol Hill, Pelosi long supported Israel, condemning efforts to boycott or sanction the country and voting in favour of military aid.

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy url Advertisement live-orange3 Oct 2026 - 23:15 (23:15 GMT)Russia’s Security Council chairman: ‘We will never sacrifice our relationship with Iran’The deputy chairman of Russia’s Security Council, Dmitry Medvedev, has said, “We will never sacrifice our relationship with Iran for the relationship with any other country”, Iran’s Fars news agency shared in a post on X.

“We and Iran are strategic partners and will remain so forever,” Medvedev remarked.

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy urllive-orange3 Oct 2026 - 23:00 (23:00 GMT)Several air strikes reported on Houthi-controlled SanaaYemeni forces have confirmed air strikes on two Houthi-controlled Yemeni cities, including Sanaa.

The strikes on the Houthi-controlled capital were first reported by local media early on Sunday.

The media centre of the armed forces of Yemen’s internationally recognised government said in a post on X that Saudi coalition forces targeted “the terrorist Houthi militia” in Sanaa and Saada.

Earlier, the Iran-aligned Houthis accused Saudi Arabia of launching at least 26 strikes against Sanaa.

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy urllive-orange3 Oct 2026 - 22:45 (22:45 GMT)WATCH: Funeral held at Gaza church for mother and daughter killed in Gaza strikeFuneral prayers were held at Gaza City’s Saint Porphyrius Greek Orthodox Church for a Palestinian mother and daughter who were among five killed in an overnight Israeli airstrike on an apartment.

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy urllive-orange3 Oct 2026 - 22:30 (22:30 GMT)More than 200,000 displaced in Yemen, clashes continueBy Hadeel al-YamamiReporting from al-Bireen, Yemen

We are now in one of the displacement camps, located between Taiz and Aden governorates. These areas have received thousands of displaced people. Humanitarian organisations say that the numbers have reached as many as 200,000 displaced.

These tents are not suitable for living or shelter. They lack even the most basic necessities. There are vulnerable groups here, including elderly people, as well as children who are living in extremely difficult conditions. They were forced to flee their homes in the districts and areas of the western coast.

These are children who have left their homes and have been displaced to these areas for more than 20 days. They have gathered some grains and plants from the valleys near the displacement sites, and lit fires to cook them.

As we speak to you, you can hear the sounds of fighting coming from behind these hills. Displaced people have not been displaced just once. Many have been forced to flee two, three, or even four times because of escalating clashes.

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy urllive-orange3 Oct 2026 - 22:15 (22:15 GMT)WATCH: Netanyahu’s fight to own the election narrativeWith elections one month away, the media discourse in Israel has narrowed in on one question about one man: What did Benjamin Netanyahu know before October 7?

The prime minister is suing the Israeli newspaper that reported the claim, while the right-wing Channel 14 insists none of it matters.

Missing from the coverage is any reckoning with what Israel has done in Gaza.

Al Jazeera’s The Listening Post unpacks the conversations around the upcoming Israeli elections.

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy urllive-orange3 Oct 2026 - 22:00 (22:00 GMT)Israel’s strikes in Gaza send message that ‘no one has immunity’Ahmed al-Tanani, a Palestinian researcher and political writer, has told Al Jazeera that civilian deaths in Israeli strikes on Gaza are not “collateral damage” but part of a deliberate message to Palestinians.

“I don’t believe they are collateral damage, even by the occupation’s own reckoning,” he said. “The occupation knows exactly the extent of the harm caused in every bombardment.”

He said Israel wants Gaza’s residents to understand that “no one has immunity in the Strip”.

“As long as you are a living Palestinian in the Strip, you are a target on the bank of targets,” he said.

Al-Tanani accused Israel of identifying victims after they are killed and then linking them to armed factions. “We saw this with journalists, we saw it with writers,” he said. He added that Israel’s message to Palestinians is that they have no path, “except to look for the option of leaving the Gaza Strip, or to receive missiles”.

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy url Advertisement live-orange3 Oct 2026 - 21:45 (21:45 GMT)Iran welcomes exit of US forces from Iraq, calls for Washington to be held accountableIran’s Foreign Ministry has congratulated the Iraqi government and people on the exit of US and other foreign forces from Iraq, in a statement posted on its Telegram channel.

The ministry called the withdrawal “a very important and necessary step” towards consolidating Iraq’s sovereignty, territorial integrity and independence.

It accused the US of causing “irreparable consequences” for Iraq and the region since the 2003 invasion, which it said was launched under the false pretext of “weapons of mass destruction”. It cited the killing of more than 1 million Iraqis, hundreds of billions of dollars in damage, abuses at Abu Ghraib prison and the rise of ISIL (ISIS).

The ministry also called for the US government to be held accountable for crimes committed during the occupation and paid tribute to Iraqi paramilitary commander Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis and Iranian general Qassem Soleimani, who were killed in a US strike in Baghdad in 2020.

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy urllive-orange3 Oct 2026 - 21:36 (21:36 GMT)Trump says Iran ‘decimated’Speaking to reporters, Trump said Iran has “virtually given up any plans of a nuclear weapon”.

He also said: “We have a decision that I’ll make about Iran. Iran has been decimated, so the only question is, it’ll either be the easy way or the hard way.”

share-grey-inversefacebookxwhatsapp-strokeLink copied!copy urllive-orange3 Oct 2026 - 21:30 (21:30 GMT)Settlers filmed trying to break into Palestinian family’s home near NablusIsraeli settlers were filmed trying to break into a Palestinian family’s home in Khirbet al-Marajim, near the village of Duma, south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, The Times of Israel has reported.

Footage shows two men, one armed, trying to force their way into the house and break down the door. In one video, the armed man can be heard threatening the family, who are inside the house and shout back at him.

The two men left after failing to get in.

The Israeli human rights organisation Torat Tzedek said the same two men had earlier attacked a teenager in the Duma area before arriving at the house.
